"""Literal server-only child. Preparation artifact: never run locally."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import time


def exclusive_json(path, value):
    with path.open("x", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
        stream.write("\n")
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())


attempt = Path(sys.argv[1])
argv = json.loads(sys.argv[2])
started = time.monotonic()
timed_out = False
with (attempt / "elaborated-stdout.txt").open("xb") as stdout, \
        (attempt / "elaborated-stderr.txt").open("xb") as stderr:
    child = subprocess.Popen(argv, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr,
                             start_new_session=True)
    try:
        exclusive_json(attempt / "lean-child-start.json", {
            "pid": child.pid, "parentPID": os.getpid(), "argv": argv,
            "startNewSession": True, "timeoutSeconds": 600,
            "identityBasis": "This live Popen object; never a persisted/restarted PID",
        })
        try:
            return_code = child.wait(timeout=600)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            timed_out = True
            # Only this worker's still-live child session may be signalled.
            if child.poll() is None:
                try:
                    os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                except ProcessLookupError:
                    pass
            try:
                return_code = child.wait(timeout=10)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                if child.poll() is None:
                    try:
                        os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                    except ProcessLookupError:
                        pass
                return_code = child.wait()
    finally:
        # Also reap our own child if recording/waiting is interrupted. A saved
        # PID from any prior process is never signalled.
        if child.poll() is None:
            try:
                os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
            except ProcessLookupError:
                pass
            child.wait()
exclusive_json(attempt / "lean-process-receipt.json", {
    "leanProcessStarted": True, "leanPID": child.pid,
    "actualLeanProcessExitCode": return_code,
    "leanElapsedSeconds": time.monotonic() - started,
    "timeoutSeconds": 600, "timedOut": timed_out, "reaped": True,
    "argv": argv, "ownedLivePIDOnly": True,
})
sys.exit(124 if timed_out else return_code)
